comment: The document correctly identifies the political economy challenge of vertical, programme-driven fragmentation but provides limited guidance on how to build coalitions, manage resistance, and create accountability frameworks that reward contributions to shared infrastructure. The case for investment also lacks a tailored value proposition for Ministries of Finance.

public.text: The document correctly identifies the political economy challenge of vertical, programme-driven fragmentation but provides limited guidance on how to build coalitions, manage resistance, and create accountability frameworks that reward contributions to shared infrastructure. The case for investment also lacks a tailored value proposition for Ministries of Finance.
public.suggestedRevision:
1) Consider adding a sub-section on navigating political economy, including: strategies for aligning donor funding with national architecture (rather than allowing parallel systems); guidance on creating accountability frameworks that reward contributions to shared infrastructure; and advice on sequencing investments to build momentum and demonstrate early value. 
2) Expand the value proposition for Ministries of Finance with metrics that resonate: reduced fraud and leakage, verifiable health expenditure, budget execution tracking, and the ability to link spending to outcomes.
